reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets doubled from ~600/month in Jun-Jul to ~1200+/month in Aug-Sep 2026 (E-05), and the majority of disputed bills (59%, 1785/3025) are built on ACTUAL meter reads rather than estimates (E-02); no tariff rate change occurred this year (E-04, E-07) and ticket response times remain within SLA (E-03). Together this indicates the surge is primarily driven by a non-tariff defect in the billing import/calculation step of the meter-to-cash process that produces incorrect bill amounts on correctly-read accounts, not by response-capacity backlog or by estimate substitution alone.
